title: Civil Maintenance to the Lighthouse tower, Allied buildings, Aerial masts and compound wall at Portonovo Lighthouse Station

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, 5/20 Jaffer Syrang Street, Chennai

sites.name: Portonovo Lighthouse Station, near Parangipettai, Cuddalore District, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Civil maintenance to lighthouse tower, allied buildings, aerial masts and compound wall

scope.item: Civil maintenance to the lighthouse tower, allied buildings, aerial masts and compound wall

money.notes: Estimated cost including 18% GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled/nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai; validity stated as three months (table) and 90 days (clause 1.1) from technical bid opening; EMD exempted for valid MSME/NSIC certificate. Tender fee Nil.

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works completed in last seven years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost; values updated at 7% simple interest per annum; certificates from officer not below Executive Engineer
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
CA-certified average annual turnover on construction works at least 40% of estimated cost in last 3 financial years ending 31 March 2025
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution
Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III), tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), non-blacklisting affidavit, relatives declaration, Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: Only Section I (NIT, printed pages 3-6) included; no BOQ. Times of submission/opening not printed. Clause numbering in terms jumps (1.5 followed by an unnumbered '1.' then 1.7).
